#include <iostream>

bool possible(int w, int m) {
    if (m <= 0) {
        return true;
    }
    int r = m % w;
    if (r == 0) {
        return possible(w, m / w);
    } else if (r == 1) {
        return possible(w, (m - 1) / w);
    } else if (r == w - 1) {
        return possible(w, (m + 1) / w);
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;
    std::cout << (possible(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO") << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
